title: Private Deployment - Network Stability Contract and Canary Rollback Criteria
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Define a concise Network Stability Contract (NSC) for Private/VPC customers that prescribes measurable networking conditions, canary rollout and rollback criteria, and upgrade gates for offline/air-gapped environments. Goal is to reduce failed upgrades and customer downtime by providing deterministic acceptance criteria for operations teams and automated checks for the install/upgrade orchestration flow.

Scope: This PRD covers networking preconditions (DNS, routing, proxy/egress rules), health and latency SLIs used during canary and staged rollouts, deterministic failure modes that must trigger automatic rollback, and additional constraints for air-gapped/offline deployments (artifact mirroring, image signing validation, and timeouts). Does NOT include per-customer firewall scripting or customer-specific KMS procedures; those are covered by onboarding runbooks.

Background: Recent canary rollouts to isolated VPC tenants surfaced flaky DNS resolution and intermittent egress proxy failures which led to stalled upgrades and manual interventions. Engineering needs a standardized contract we can assert in the bootstrap and upgrade orchestration that maps to clear runbook actions and UX signals in Console (canary state, rollback reason).

Success metrics: Reduce manual upgrade rollbacks by 40% for VPC customers during the first two rollout waves; cut mean time to detect a networking-induced failed canary from average 22 minutes to under 7 minutes; provide a machine-readable NSC that the orchestration can auto-validate during preflight.
acceptance_criteria: NSC document published (Confluence) with machine-readable checklist and mapping to orchestration failure codes

Bootstrap preflight implements at least 6 network checks (DNS resolve for registry domains, egress TCP connectivity to mirrors, split-horizon DNS detection, MTU/synack checks, proxy authentication health, time drift within tolerance) and returns standard status codes

Canary rollout policy updated to evaluate SLOs (pod start latency, initial KV cache warm-up, first-token latency) and network SLIs; a single failing network SLI must trigger automatic rollback during canary window
Upgrade orchestration exposes explicit rollback reasons in Console and in customer upgrade logs (egress-timeout, dns-failure, image-mirror-mismatch), and includes remediation suggestions
Air-gapped validation flow supports offline image signing verification and mirror checksum validation; if checksum mismatch, upgrade is aborted and a 'mirror-error' code is emitted
Automated test harness for NSC with synthetic fault injection (DNS blackhole, proxy 407, mirror delayed responses) runs in CI and gates the release
Runbook and operator checklist updated and published; runbook includes manual fallback and escalation steps for persistent network partitioning
tasks: Draft NSC canonical fields and state machine for preflight validation (PM + Eng)
Implement preflight network checks in bootstrap agent (Eng)
Add SLI hooks and evaluation window to canary controller (Eng)
Map orchestration error codes to Console UI messages and telemetry (PM + Product UX + Eng)
Create CI fault-injection tests for at least three failure classes (DNS, proxy auth, mirror checksum) (Eng + QA)
Draft runbook and operator checklist and run internal tabletop exercise (PM + SRE)
Coordinate with Legal/Security for air-gap image signing acceptance criteria (PM)
Pilot with two customers in isolated VPCs and capture telemetry (Solutions Eng)
Rollout communication plan and training for Customer Success and Onboarding teams
notes: Trade-offs: stricter NSC preflight reduces rollout velocity for some customers with brittle networks; propose a 'strict' and 'permissive' profile for customers during onboarding
We will represent security_review_required as a binary flag and surface additional requirements in the Confluence doc
Canary rollback needs to avoid oscillation; implement a cooldown period (TBD by Eng) and max N retries before marking rollout as failed
Edge-case: asymmetric routing where control-plane connectivity differs from data-plane; include probes from both control-plane and node-namespace contexts
Metric instrumentation: emit 'nsc.preflight.status' with labels for check type and outcome to Console and to telemetry export
